title: NodeVault ToolFunction build raw_spec v1
description: Machine-checkable, NodeVault-owned schema for the second-image ToolFunction build raw_spec (kind=2). It is exact: exactly these four fields, no additional or unknown fields, no trailing content. This schema governs raw_spec identity/derivation only; it does NOT enable kind=2 build execution (W3-PRE).

schema_version.description: Self-identifying schema id; must equal the schema $id exactly.

base_image_digest.description: Pinned base image digest. Hex case is normalized to lowercase before v1 identity derivation, so upper/lower spellings converge to one identity.

script.description: The ToolFunction build script source content. Identity-bearing; must contain at least one non-whitespace character (matches the runtime parser, which rejects a blank/whitespace-only script).
